name: Cadenza FX
_comment: Insert-effect variant of ../vst (same cadenza_vst.cpp, parameters and skin): 'effect' makes gen_vst.py emit PLUG_EFFECT in params.h and a category=Effect plugin-list entry, so Cadenza loads as an insert and takes none of the 8 plugin instrument slots. Audio passes through untouched; notes go out through the plugin's own ALSA port 'Cadenza FX'.
